coupling_interpretation: For this segmented image, water exists as disconnected components. A full-water coupled solve is block-diagonal unless a physical water throat connects components; therefore coupled and uncoupled outputs are expected to be nearly identical for the current segmentation.
model_limitations: Uses existing segmented water phase only.
Does not solve Young-Laplace/minimum-energy saturation redistribution.
T2-T2 and D-T2 are reduced maps derived from the full-resolution PDE T2 response; strict PFG complex PDE is not enabled in this quick run.
